topic: Exploring the 2-adic Metric: Where Infinite Sums Behave Differently

sections.title: The Familiar World: Real Convergence
lecture_lines: Standard convergence relies on Euclidean distance.
Points close if distance is small.
Like an ant approaching a crumb.
animations: Highlight 'Standard convergence relies on Euclidean distance' (#FFFFFF).
Display sequence points 1, 1/2, 1/4... represented by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/crumb.svg] in blue (#0000FF).
Animate [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ant.svg] (red circle (#FF0000) border) around L, shrinking towards it.

sections.title: Introduction to the 2-adic Metric
lecture_lines: 2-adic distance uses power of two factors.
Divisibility by high powers implies closeness.
Structure resembles a branching tree of numbers.
animations: Highlight '2-adic distance uses power of two factors' (#FFFF00).
Show two numbers x and y as points on a line using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg].
Animate distance shrinking as power of 2 increases using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg].

sections.title: Infinite Sums in 2-adic Space
lecture_lines: Convergence happens if terms approach zero.
Binary bits build toward negative one.
animations: Highlight 'Convergence happens if terms approach zero' (#FFFFFF).
Show sequence of partial sums S_n in blue (#0000FF).
Animate S_n moving towards -1 in 2-adic sense. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg]

sections.title: Divergence vs. Convergence: The Shifted Lens
lecture_lines: Digital clocks show binary bit growth.
animations: Show divergent series in real line as escaping infinity [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/clock.svg].
Show same series in 2-adic line converging to finite value [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/clock.svg].

sections.title: Conclusion and Intuition Check
lecture_lines: Closeness depends on how we define it.
animations: Highlight 'Closeness depends on how we define it' (#ADD8E6).
